login.title: Channel manang shang wa ai
login.registerLink: Na a account hpe jahpan bang u
login.welcome: Bai hkap tau la ga! Na a lead ni hpe hparan na matu sign in galaw u.
login.heroTitle: Nang la sa ai ningbaw shagu hte na a real-estate hpaga lam hpe rawt jat wa shangun u
login.heroIntro: Portal langai mi gaw, nta gap ai ni hte customers ni hpe mying jahpan bang na matu, na a lead ni a credit hpe tawn da nna, booking galaw ai du hkra shanhte hpe hkan nang na matu re.

register.title: Second loi mi laman hta ningbaw ningla ni hpe jahpan bang u
register.text: Na a customer hte shanhte myit lawm ai project hpe bang dat u.

protect.title: Duplicate makawp maga ai lam
protect.text: Na a lead gaw makawp maga ai aten laman na a matu sha nga ai majaw, kaga kadai mung dai customer langai hpe n mai hpyi shawn ai.

track.title: Stage shagu hpe hkan tam u
track.text: Shawng ningnan matut mahkai ai kaw nna booking galaw ai du hkra, ningbaw langai hpra a status hte labau tup hkrak hpe yu u.

handover.title: Booking galaw ai shaloi credit
handover.text: Customer langai booking galaw ai shaloi, lead hpe source partner hku nna nang hpe ka da ai hte rau, nta galaw ai wa hpe ap ya ai.

login.secure: Hkamja lam hte shang wa u - na a mari ai ni a lam hpe makoi magap da na
login.builderPrompt: Nang gaw nta gawgap ai wa rai ni?

signup.title: Channel manang ni a mying jahpan bang ai lam
signup.intro: Tinang a lead ni hpe registration galaw hpang na matu hte manage galaw hpang na matu account hpe hpaw u.
